2115772991938138452.en_summary: @bespokeinvest says Alphabet $GOOGL, public since 2004, is down 11% pre-market on earnings. It has never fallen more than 10% on an earnings reaction day, so today could be a first, with its market cap set to drop by about $400 billion at the open. An image is attached.
2115772991938138452.zh_summary: @bespokeinvest 表示自 2004 年上市的 Alphabet $GOOGL 因財報盤前下跌 11%。該股歷來在財報反應日跌幅從未超過 10%，今天可能是首次，開市時市值預計蒸發約 4,000 億美元。附上圖片。

2115773979411787890.en_summary: @dampedspring says $MSFT is offering benchmark debt in 10 maturities for the first time since 2017, declaring "Capital 'lite' is dead." An image is attached.
2115773979411787890.zh_summary: @dampedspring 表示 $MSFT 自 2017 年以來首次發行涵蓋 10 個年期的基準債券，並稱「輕資本模式已死」。附上圖片。

2115774542497104207.en_summary: @RedDogT3 says $SPX futures are down 14 points after a busy earnings night. $GOOGL is the standout, $NOW and $FTNT are getting hit and $MSFT is off the highs. With the FOMC behind us, he is watching 7767 support and 7776 resistance. An image is attached, and he quotes his #6:30 Club broadcast link.
2115774542497104207.zh_summary: @RedDogT3 表示在業績密集公布的一夜後，$SPX 期貨下跌 14 點。$GOOGL 表現突出，$NOW 與 $FTNT 受壓，$MSFT 則從高位回落。聯儲局議息已過，他關注 7767 支撐位與 7776 阻力位。附上圖片，並引用其 #6:30 Club 直播連結。

2115775446986178803.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says $MSFT is looking to raise at least $25B through a U.S. bond offering.
2115775446986178803.zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示 $MSFT 計劃透過美國債券發行籌集至少 250 億美元。

2115776248886526090.en_summary: (Reposted by @carlquintanilla) @knowledge_vital says that to see how farmers are doing, look at $AGCO's remarks: "the weakest global industry demand environment in more than a decade", with elevated input costs and uncertainty around commodity markets and trade pushing industry demand below the last cyclical trough.
2115776248886526090.zh_summary: （由 @carlquintanilla 轉發）@knowledge_vital 表示，想了解農民的處境，可以看看 $AGCO 的說法：「十多年來最疲弱的全球行業需求環境」，投入成本高企，加上大宗商品市場和貿易環境的不確定性，令行業需求跌破上一個週期低谷。
